messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: two quick policy updates + a mandatory refresh. TL;DR: starting June 1 -> PTO accrual for interns and contractors changes, caregiver leave increased, and a simplified low-cost travel approval path. Also everyone must complete a short Code of Conduct micro-training by June 14. Details below and links. Please react :eyes: when youve seen it.

Diego (Eng): Thanks Maya. What's changing for contractors exactly?

Maya (People Ops): Contractors and interns will now accrue pro-rated PTO at 0.75 days/month for assignments 3+ months (was 0.5). This only applies to roles on Redwood payroll umbrella or long-term contractors with at least 3 months tenure. Short engagements unchanged.

Lina (Sales): Caregiver leave  is that the same as parental or a separate bucket?

Maya (People Ops): Separate but similar. Caregiver leave (for caring for seriously ill family member) increases from 4 weeks to 8 weeks paid. Parental leave remains at 16 weeks. Both are available under the new policy and can be used consecutively if eligible.

Omar (Legal): Any visa/immigration implications for extended leaves we should flag to managers?

Maya (People Ops): Good catch. Managers should consult with Legal for visa-sponsored employees as leave can affect status. We included guidance in the policy doc and Legal will be looped on requests that touch immigration.

Diego (Eng): Travel approval flow  how does fast-track work? Manager-only?

Maya (People Ops): Fast-track for trips under $2k: manager approval + auto finance check (no Exec sign-off). For multi-person vendor or booth spends still require finance + programs approval. Use travel-fasttrack form in Confluence.

hr-bot: ACTION: Code of Conduct micro-training assigned to all employees. Complete by June 14. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/learning/coc-micro. Completion recorded.

Lina (Sales): Will recruiting update offer language / handbook?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, handbook and offer templates updated today. Recruiting and People Ops will push updated templates and an FAQ doc.

Diego (Eng): Will existing PTO balances change for contractors?

Maya (People Ops): No retroactive changes to balances. Changes apply from June 1 forward.

Omar (Legal): Please add a note in the policy about state-specific leave laws. We should ensure the policy supplements, not replaces, statutory rights.

Maya (People Ops): Added. The policy has a "state law" addendum and Legal reviewed it.

Diego (Eng): :white_check_mark: got it

Lina (Sales): Can you drop a one-sheeter for team heads?

Maya (People Ops): Will do  dropping a one-sheeter here and pinning it in #people-ops. If you want a slide deck for your 1:1s ping me.

Maya (People Ops): Links: policy doc: https://redwood-internal.company/policies/leave-travel-update | travel form: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/travel-fasttrack | exceptions: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/exception-request
